summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Motesart Number System Converter with status flow improvements, branded templates, and file type support. All core features working correctly with one minor PDF export issue.

flaky_endpoints.workaround: Use CSV or Text export formats which work correctly

API /api/auth/register creates user with email/password
API /api/auth/login works with email/password authentication
API /api/upload accepts PDF files and stores with 'uploaded' status
API /api/upload accepts PNG/JPG images and stores with 'uploaded' status
API /api/upload accepts MIDI files and converts with 'completed' status
API /api/conversions returns user's conversion history with status field
API /api/export/{id}?format=csv generates CSV with branded header
API /api/export/{id}?format=text generates text with branded header and legend

Dashboard shows symbol legend footer for completed conversions
